dimensions.assessment: Affects manufacturers, purchasers, and occupants of manufactured housing by removing mandatory energy efficiency regulations.
dimensions.evidence: Energy Conservation Program: Energy Conservation Standards for Manufactured Housing

dimensions.assessment: Nullifies existing energy conservation rules and restricts future federal standard recommendations based on cost-effectiveness criteria.
dimensions.evidence: The final rule... shall have no force or effect.

dimensions.assessment: Potentially affects life-cycle construction and operating costs for manufactured homes, though no direct federal spending amounts are stated.
dimensions.evidence: taking into consideration life cycle construction and operating costs

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007 to alter recommendation authorities and nullify agency regulations.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may transmit to the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development recommendations for revisions

dimensions.assessment: Implements permanent changes to federal energy standards authority and permanently voids the specified 2022 final rule.

missing_information: Exact figures on cost savings or purchase price changes for manufactured homes are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill rescinds a specific Department of Energy final rule on energy efficiency standards for manufactured housing and modifies statutory criteria for future recommendations to HUD.
